title: Two Coworkers Two Replacement Faces
tests: Tests explicit multi-face mapping and stable identity tracking across a two-person video without changing the original scene or sound.

faults.what: The male portrait identity is missing: the left coworker remains a younger, brown-haired man with substantially different facial features, while the central coworker retains his dark-haired, bearded appearance. Neither recognizably matches portrait-man.jpg.

judge.summary: The woman resembles her supplied portrait, but neither male coworker matches the man's portrait, leaving half of the requested face swap unfulfilled.

must_haves.item: The output contains the full 10-second office exchange from talk-two.mp4.
must_haves.why: The output runs approximately 10 seconds and shows the office scene throughout the supplied samples, but the complete original exchange is unavailable for comparison.

must_haves.item: The male coworker's face recognizably matches portrait-man.jpg and the female coworker's face recognizably matches portrait-woman.jpg.
must_haves.why: The foreground woman resembles the woman's portrait, including her facial features and dark curls, but neither man resembles the older, gray-haired man in the supplied portrait.

must_haves.item: The two replacement identities never switch between coworkers or collapse into the same face.
must_haves.why: The coworkers remain visually distinct and consistently assigned across all four output samples; no identity switching or collapse is visible, although the requested male identity is absent.

must_haves.item: Both faces stay aligned through head turns and speaking, without conspicuous flickering or original-face reappearance.
must_haves.why: Faces appear aligned in the sampled poses, including the woman's profile, but still frames cannot establish flicker-free tracking through the intervening motion.

must_haves.item: The original office, camera movement and shot timing remain; the two people's hair and clothing may follow their portraits so they are recognisable.
must_haves.why: The office setting and general composition are retained, and the woman's portrait-based hair and sweater are permitted. Original camera movement and shot timing cannot be compared from one source frame.

must_haves.item: Both original voices remain audible and synchronized, with no added music or narration.
must_haves.why: The supplied audio description confirms audible speech, but does not establish preservation of both original voices, lip synchronization, or the absence of added music or narration.
